entries.en: to learn; to imitate
entries.notes: R 栏对音 emlap/iomlap 存疑且与「學」不谐，释义据 L/H/M 三栏（aprender＝学、imitar＝模仿）。

entries.en: to learn the Way/doctrine; to learn reason

entries.zh: 学业；所学之业（兼指所习行当）
entries.en: studies; what one has learned (also the trade learned)
entries.notes: L 栏释义后半潦草残缺，可辨者仅 aprender off.o（oficio＝行当/职事），据 H/M/R 三栏定为「学业」。

entries.en: to learn courtesy/etiquette
to imitate well; to model oneself on the good

entries.zh: 照样仿效；效尤（旧指仿效他人所为，多含坏样）
entries.en: to imitate in like manner; to follow another's example (especially a bad precedent)
entries.notes: 汉字栏「由/尤」存疑：作「效尤」指仿效（多含坏样），西语栏则作 imitar lo bien（仿善），姑取「照样仿效」为通义。

entries.en: to learn; to study a lesson

entries.zh: 学官；为应试做官而读书求学
entries.en: to study in order to become a mandarin (official)

entries.zh: 学乖；经阅历而变得乖觉（吃一堑长一智）
entries.en: to grow shrewd by experience; to learn one's lesson

entries.zh: 学工夫；学习做工的本领、手艺
entries.en: to learn a trade; to learn how to work
to learn to do/make something

entries.zh: 却巧（存疑：好奇注视而学、似懂非懂）
entries.en: to learn by curious observation without understanding (tentative)
entries.notes: 「却巧」非通行词，西语栏主段可辨（aprender atendiendo con curiosidad, y no entendiéndolo）而尾段残缺，姑以大意释之。

entries.zh: 却巧样（存疑：貌似学得而实未了然之态）
entries.en: the seeming manner of learning without understanding (tentative)
entries.notes: L 栏尾词残缺；「样」承上条「却巧」缀出，据西语大意推译。

entries.zh: 却巧话（存疑：留神听看而学得的话；学舌）
entries.en: speech learned by attentive watching/listening without full understanding (tentative)
entries.notes: L 栏尾词残缺；「话」承「却巧」缀出，据西语大意推译。

entries.zh: 习艺；学习任意一门技艺/手艺
entries.en: to learn any craft or trade
what one has learned; one's learning
apprentice; one learning a trade under a master
〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: L 栏尾词涂黑（aprestar/aprender 存疑），汉字栏「擲/捃」字形存疑，M/R 对音与西语栏不谐，四栏无法互证。

entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 西语栏 aprestar/apessar 与汉字栏「榛/梀/桀」均存疑，M（çē vn）/R（guīe）对音不谐，语义无法定夺。

entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: L 栏中后段残缺（他读 xon coatsa），首字「相」可辨而后接字与上条 19 同为难考之「榛/梀」，义未定。

entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: L 栏多字难辨且他读全异（Apresionad…），M 栏小字斜插记号难辨，R 栏存疑，四栏不谐，义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 匆忙书写；赶写（汉字首字存疑）
entries.en: to write hastily; to write in a hurry
entries.notes: 西语栏 apresurad en escriuir（匆忙书写）明晰、第二字「写」三栏可证，但首字「勒」与 M/R 对音难吻合，释义以西语栏为准。
